copy:
You were there.
I was here.
visual: High dreamy overhead public square or open court on warm ivory paper. Zuv is a small steady figure on one side, Aachu is a small expressive figure far away on the opposite side. Their locations clearly prove the text: he is there, she is here. Long soft shadows and faint walking paths show distance without sadness. No decorative hearts, no ribbons, no red string, no UI, no copied dark screenshot styling.
pose: Both are distant but readable through posture: Aachu mid-step and expressive, Zuv steady and unhurried, both facing different directions. Keep the faces tiny or partly turned, but preserve hair silhouette, body proportions, and wardrobe anchors.
wardrobe: Aachu: white or cream top with denim and a red patterned scarf or red bag as her recognizable color cue. Zuv: navy or black casual layer, tan trousers, watch, casual sneakers.
props: Only public-square lines, soft shadows, and faint route marks. No heart charm, no tied thread, no symbolic ribbon.
background: Airy overhead public square with soft faded edges, muted slate-blue ground wash, warm ivory negative space in the upper-middle for text.
cta_intent: Preserve the reference text spine and make the visuals prove the exact line with real staging, not decorative symbolism.
